method.inputs: n=m, dyadic x/P/Q/R/z; alpha=1 beta=2 kappa=0; identical q15-grid starting particles
method.model: f_j=.875*x_j+.0625*x_next; h_j=.75*x_j+.125*x_next; add .03125*x_j^2 to f and .0625*x_j^2 to h
method.draws: mt19937 seed 0x51f15 + libstdc++ normal_distribution<double>, precomputed and q15-grid rounded
method.timed: successful whole transactions including native callbacks, staged commits and validation
method.excluded: allocation/init, initial-state restoration, normal RNG generation, output checks
method.memory: one instance: persistent arrays + state descriptor + max per-operation reusable workspace + PF estimate outputs; excludes stack, inputs, callback state, allocator overhead and benchmark lanes
method.limits: host wall-time only; no MCU execution; Linux scheduling/turbo variation is not controlled
